title: LVN to RN Career Mobility Program

program.section_heading: LVN TO RN CAREER MOBILITY PROGRAM ASSOCIATE IN SCIENCE
outcomes: Evaluate nursing care provided to clients, families, groups, populations, and communities from diverse backgrounds in a variety of settings to ensure that it is compassionate, age and culturally appropriate and based on a client's preferences, values and needs.
Collaborate with members of the interprofessional healthcare team to manage and coordinate client care.
Demonstrate use of current evidence and clinical expertise when making clinical decisions.
Integrate technologies into practice that support clinical judgment in the management of client care.
Use quality improvement strategies to effect change in the delivery of client care.
Evaluate effectiveness of strategies used to support a culture of safety that reduces the risk of injury to patients, self and others
Integrate accountable and responsible behaviors that uphold established regulatory, legal, and ethical principles.
Use leadership, management and priority-setting skills in the provision and management of safe, quality client-centered care.
Use communication skills that promote an effective exchange of information, development of therapeutic relationships, and shared decision making.

notes: The catalog prints 'TOTAL UNITS REQUIRED FOR DEGREE MAJOR 24', recorded as total_units.
The sentence 'Students must complete a total of 60 degree applicable units to earn an AA or AS' is a general statement for all AA/AS degrees, not recorded as degree_total.

ge_units 21 comes from the boilerplate sentence 'a minimum of 21 units of General Education requirements'; ge_pattern named as Yuba College General Education based on that sentence and the GE area references in the prerequisites; reviewer should confirm.

Catalog titles and units differ from the closed list for NURS 14A (catalog: Adult Health III with Leadership, 6.5 units; state file: Nursing Care of Clients with Multisystem Disorders, 4 units) and NURS 14B (catalog: Integrated Nursing Concepts: NCLEX-RN Readiness, 1.5 units; state file: Transition to professional practice, 4 units). Catalog units recorded.

Prerequisite coursework (BIOL 4, BIOL 5, BIOL 6, ENGL C1000, STAT C1000 or PSYCH 6, CHEM 2A, HLTH 10, PSYC C1000, SOCIL 1 or ANTHR 2, COMM C1000 or SPECH 6, Arts and Humanities course, Ethnic Studies course, NURS 12C) is required for admission, not part of the 24-unit major; not placed in blocks.
The program learning outcomes are printed for the program as a whole; this A.S. award shares them.
